monetary_impact.tariff_documentation: Based on Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (CERC) Deviation Settlement Mechanism (DSM) frequency deviation regulations, penalizing grid over-drawl / under-drawl at INR 6.50 to 8.50/kWh (approx.
